newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bernheim-Comofi sees return to profit.
newsitem.headline: Bernheim-Comofi sees return to profit.

text.p: Belgian property company Bernheim-Comofi said on Friday it was positive about its future after plunging into the red in 1996 because of charges linked to an investment in Berlin, Germany.

"Bernheim's focus on a number of restricted activities in property with a high value-added allows one to forecast a favourable development of the company in the coming years and a return to profit from 1997," it said in a statement.
Bernheim said a 375 million franc writedown on its Berlin investment pushed it to a 160 million franc loss in 1996 after it made 426 million francs profit in 1996.
The company said it would propose shareholders maintain the gross dividend at an unchanged 100 francs a share.
